transport: RS-485 on two RJ-45 jacks marked COMM 1 and COMM 2, vendor-documented as "For RS-485 networking and MODBUS Serial Communication Protocol". Baud rate, framing, parity and default slave ID are NOT published by Samlex and are recorded here as null. Separate RJ-45 jacks COMM 3 and COMM 4 are documented as CANbus "(for future use)".

models.name: Samlex EVO-4024 — the inverter/charger half of MNEVO4024-CL150

gotchas: NO PUBLIC REGISTER MAP, same as the EVO-4248SP. The manual documents the ports and stops. Tagged unverified for the same reason: the map does not exist publicly, and the only claims about it are uncorroborated forum reports of an NDA-gated stack.

KEPT SEPARATE FROM THE EVO-4248SP DELIBERATELY, AND THE EVIDENCE POINTS THE SAME WAY. It would be easy to fold both EVO models into one "samlex-evo" dialect. Do not. There is no map for either, so there is nothing to share — and the vendor documentation actively suggests two firmware lines: the EVO-4024 ships in a manu

IF ANY GROUPING EVER BECOMES JUSTIFIED, IT IS 2212/3012/2224/4024 — NOT 4024+4248SP. Those four share one manual and one stated firmware rev, which is suggestive but is still only a shared MANUAL, not a shared register map. It does not meet the bar. Recorded so the possibility is not rediscovered as a finding.

Same dry-contact generator auto-start as the 4248SP: manual section 4.7, Status Relay Common/NO, external GSCM-Mini module required, logic chosen from options 2/3/4 on the EVO-RC. Front-panel legend item 14 reads "Status Relay Terminals for initiating automatic generator start/stop". Contacts 3 A at 125 VAC / 30 VDC. O
Same lithium-BMS stop-charging/stop-inverting input on the RJ-45 marked "Battery Temp. Sensor" (pins 1–4 shorted, pins 5–8 shorted).
unmappedReports: Same three as the EVO-4248SP entry, and for the same reason — AC source in use / transfer-switch position, Power Saving mode state, and the "GS DETECT TIME" pre-start countdown. All are EVO-RC display quantities with no MetricKind, and none is reachable over a wire today.
